_help: role: pick | backup | alt | 2012. status: candidate | called | quoted | held | booked | dropped. 'facts' tags: C = confirmed from a current web source (Oct 2026), I = inferred, B = carried over from the 2012 book.

bgkoa.name: Bowling Green KOA Holiday
bgkoa.address: 1960 Three Springs Rd, Bowling Green, KY
bgkoa.sites: 148 sites; full-hookup pull-throughs, 30/50 A; up to 100 ft
bgkoa.group: Conference center seats 75+ banquet-style; pavilion. ACI caravans started here 2023-25.
bgkoa.drive: About 40 min to the Mammoth Cave visitor center (I)
bgkoa.reviews: RV LIFE 9.1/10 (327); Campendium 4.1 (13). Some I-65 noise, some uneven gravel.
bgkoa.notes: Road construction on Three Springs Rd has removed some signage.

cavecountry.name: Cave Country RV Campground
cavecountry.sites: 51 sites; full hookups, 30/50 A, all pull-through; about 45 ft
cavecountry.group: No group space listed. 26 rigs would fill half the park.
cavecountry.reviews: Campendium 4.8 (63), many 5-star reviews in 2026. Some train noise.

jellystone.name: Jellystone Park at Mammoth Cave (Sun Outdoors)
jellystone.address: 950 Mammoth Cave Rd, Cave City, KY
jellystone.sites: About 159 RV sites; mostly full hookups, 30/50 A; many pull-throughs 50-70 ft
jellystone.group: Paired buddy sites; a groups section exists.
jellystone.reviews: Campendium 3.0 (5): kids, golf carts, cleanliness complaints. About $128/night plus resort fee.
jellystone.notes: Family resort; pricey for a caravan.

diamondcaverns.name: Diamond Caverns RV Resort (Thousand Trails)
diamondcaverns.address: 1878 Mammoth Cave Pkwy, Park City, KY
diamondcaverns.sites: 68 sites; full hookups, 30/50 A; 50 ft max
diamondcaverns.reviews: Campendium 4.0 (37). 2025 reviews: red-clay sites hard to level, some interior roads rough.
diamondcaverns.notes: Closest to the cave; ask for site assignments ahead.

dadsbluegrass.name: Dad's Bluegrass Campground (2012: Bluegrass Music RV Park)
dadsbluegrass.sites: 88 sites; 30/50 A full hookups, mostly pull-through
dadsbluegrass.notes: 2012 base. New name and new owner; the book's (270) 586-5622 is dead. Too far from the cave.

louisvillesouthkoa.name: Louisville South KOA Holiday
louisvillesouthkoa.sites: 148 full-hookup RV sites; 30/50 A; pull-throughs up to 90 ft
louisvillesouthkoa.group: 10+ sites counts as a group; staff can put sites together; pavilion seats 30. Derby is a special event: 2-night minimum, cancel 2 weeks ahead or lose the deposit.
louisvillesouthkoa.reviews: RV LIFE 8.2/10 (417); Campendium 4.0 (32). About $80/night reported Mar 2026.
louisvillesouthkoa.notes: Ask for Derby-week rates and minimum stays in writing.

grandmas.name: Grandma's RV Park
grandmas.group: No group terms posted. 26 rigs would take about 40% of the park.
grandmas.reviews: The Dyrt 4.0 (6, positive May-Jul 2026); Campendium 3.2 (12). I-65 and flea-market noise. About $50/night (Nov 2024).
grandmas.notes: 2012 park: same name and phone, still family-run.

louisvillenorth.name: Louisville North Campground (no longer a KOA)
louisvillenorth.sites: 108 sites; 30/50 A full hookups; tight gravel sites
louisvillenorth.drive: 15-20 min to Churchill Downs, more in Derby traffic (I)
louisvillenorth.reviews: Campendium 3.1 (25): trains at night, cramped sites (2025).

elkhorn.name: Elkhorn Creek RV Park (was Elkhorn Campground)
elkhorn.sites: About 118 RV sites; 20/30/50 A, water, sewer; 9 pull-throughs; back-ins 70+ ft
elkhorn.group: Pavilion and buddy sites. Open Road Resorts bought it in June 2026; no rally policy posted.
elkhorn.drive: About 15 min to Buffalo Trace; about 30 min to Keeneland (I)
elkhorn.reviews: Campspot 4.9 (8); Campendium 4.0 (24): clean, friendly, tight sites.
elkhorn.notes: Flood risk: evacuated in the April 2025 Elkhorn Creek flood. Use I-64 exit 58.

whisperinghills.name: Whispering Hills RV Park
whisperinghills.sites: About 221 sites (128 bookable online); 30/50 A full hookups; 49 pull-throughs
whisperinghills.group: Hosted a 52-rig rally in 2024; heated pavilion.
whisperinghills.drive: About 30 min to Buffalo Trace; 25-30 min to Keeneland (I)
whisperinghills.reviews: Campspot 4.7 (329); Campendium 4.1 (47): tight sites, little shade, some highway noise.
whisperinghills.notes: Could serve Frankfort and Lexington as one base.

cumminsferry.name: Cummins Ferry RV Resort & Marina
cumminsferry.reviews: Campspot 4.6 (92); Campendium 3.8 (24). Last mile is narrow, steep and single-lane.
cumminsferry.notes: Access road is a concern for 26 rigs.

khp.name: Kentucky Horse Park Campground
khp.address: 4089 Iron Works Pike, Lexington, KY (mail: Attention: Campground)
khp.sites: 260 paved back-ins, 55 ft; 20/30/50 A plus water; no sewer at sites (2 dump stations)
khp.group: Groups of 20+ book by phone. Standard bookings open 1 year ahead. Pavilion rentable.
khp.reviews: The Dyrt 4.0 (50); Campendium 4.1 (53): clean, mostly level; Loop B less level.
khp.notes: 2012 park, same name and phone. Horse-trials weekend (Kentucky Three-Day Event) has a 5-night minimum; arriving May 7 avoids it.

renfrokoa.name: Renfro Valley KOA Holiday
renfrokoa.address: 184 KOA Campground Rd, Mount Vernon, KY
renfrokoa.sites: 97 sites; 30/50 A full hookups; pull-throughs to 75 ft
renfrokoa.group: Pavilion and group meeting facilities. The 2025 ACI caravan ended here. No cash after 6/1/26.
renfrokoa.drive: About 20 min to Berea; 1 mi to the Renfro Valley shows (I)
renfrokoa.reviews: Campendium 3.9 (8): friendly hosts; steep entry road, some uneven gravel.
renfrokoa.notes: Ask about reserving the pavilion for the Sun May 21 farewell.

ohkentucky.name: Oh Kentucky Campground
ohkentucky.sites: 80-96 sites; 30/50 A full hookups; all pull-through, up to 80 ft
ohkentucky.reviews: Campendium 4.0 (12); The Dyrt 4.5 (8): clean, friendly, sites close together.

fortboonesborough.name: Fort Boonesborough State Park
fortboonesborough.sites: 166 sites; 30/50 A; only 18 full hookups; 75 ft max
fortboonesborough.group: Activities building seats 150: a farewell-banquet option.
fortboonesborough.reviews: Campendium 3.7 (12): clean bathhouses; highway and quarry noise.

musicvalley.name: Music Valley RV Park at Renfro Valley (2012: Renfro Valley RV Park)
musicvalley.sites: 114 sites (79 at 30 A, 35 at 50 A; 97 with sewer; 54 pull-through)
musicvalley.group: On the Entertainment Center grounds; no group space listed.
musicvalley.notes: Same address as the 2012 park; the rename is inferred.
